attributes.name: Carnivorous Stump
attributes.powers:
If you play an ally that has the Animal trait during this encounter, banish it.

If undefeated, each other character at your location is dealt 1 Combat damage, then end your turn.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
